name: m2a1_protect_npc
_comment: M2a.1 scenario c) Protect: trigger 'Wache NPC tot = defeat' (mission class Protect per the derivation table), no roundLimit. While nothing menaces the guard the effective posture is Eliminate and the killable 1-vitality rebel holds the focus. Once a rebel enters the threat range of the Wache (terrain cost <= speed+1), the threshold 'Objekt unter Angriff' flips the posture with a public log entry and the focus tilts onto that rebel.
